title: Admission is free
goal: Read and write definitions, rules and notices with the formal -DIr.

intro.text: Signs, rules and definitions put `-DIr` on their statements, with the usual harmony: *Giriş ücretsizdir*, *Müze pazartesi günleri kapalıdır*, *Son başvuru tarihi 15 Mart'tır*. After a tense it gives formal rules and announcements: *yapılmalıdır*, *yapılacaktır*.

vocab.en: to be necessary (gerekmektedir: it is required)
application (son başvuru tarihi: deadline for applications)
period, length of time; time limit

exercises.question: Which is correct? (The museum is closed on Mondays.)

why.2: After a vowel the d stays d: *kapalıdır*.

exercises.explain: Last vowel ı, last sound a vowel: *kapalı-dır*.

reject.why: The last vowel of *ücretsiz* is i, a front vowel: *-dir*.
z is voiced, so the d stays: *-dir*.

exercises.hint: The last vowel is i; is the last sound, z, voiced or voiceless?
exercises.explain: *ücretsiz-dir*: four-way harmony on i, and d after the voiced z.

exercises.en: The deadline for applications is 15 March.

reject.why: *Mart* ends in a voiceless t, so the d becomes t: *Mart'tır*.

exercises.hint: Say the word: *mart*. Is the last sound voiced or voiceless?
exercises.explain: *Mart'-tır*: back vowel a, voiceless t. The apostrophe stays, since the month is part of a date.

reject.why: The last vowel of *zorunlu* is u: *zorunludur*.

exercises.explain: *Kask takmak zorunlu-dur*: the infinitive is the subject, `-DIr` makes it a rule.

exercises.prompt: Bu belge resmî kurumlarda geçerli değildir.
accept: This document is not valid at official institutions.
This document is not valid [in|for|with] official institutions.
This document is not valid at official [bodies|agencies|offices].
This document is not valid [in|for|with] official [bodies|agencies|offices].

exercises.question: *Başvurular internet üzerinden yapılmalıdır.* What does the notice say?

exercises.prompt: The museum is closed on Mondays.
exercises.explain: On a sign or a website: *kapalı-dır*. *Pazartesi günleri* is **on Mondays**.

exercises.en: The meeting will be held at 2 p.m.
exercises.explain: Future `-(y)AcAk` + `-DIr`: after the voiceless k, *-tır*, with back-vowel harmony: *yapılacaktır*.

exercises.prompt: Bu bilet sadece bir gün geçerlidir.
exercises.text: This ticket is valid for one day only.
accept: This ticket is only valid for one day.
This ticket is valid only for one day.

exercises.en: Smoking is forbidden in this area.

accept: You need to pay a fee for the application.
You need to pay a fee to apply.
You [have|are required] to pay a fee [for the application|to apply].
You must pay a fee [for the application|to apply].
A fee must be paid [for the application|to apply].

exercises.task: Write a short notice (three or four sentences) for a museum, a library or a sports centre: opening days, the price, and one rule. Use `-DIr`, and once `-mAlIdIr`, *gereklidir* or *gerekmektedir*.
models: Müzemiz salıdan pazara kadar 09.00 ile 18.00 arasında açıktır. Pazartesi günleri kapalıdır. Giriş ücreti yetişkinler için 200 liradır; öğrenciler için giriş ücretsizdir. Müze içinde fotoğraf çekmek yasaktır.
Kütüphanemiz hafta içi her gün açıktır. Girişte kimlik kartı gereklidir. Kitapları en fazla on beş gün için ödünç alabilirsiniz. Okuma salonunda telefonla konuşmak yasaktır.
checklist: Days and times: *salıdan pazara kadar*, *pazartesi günleri*
The reader addressed as *siz*, if at all: *alabilirsiniz*
